description_full: Jingbo Technology, Inc., a technology company, provides smart parking application software and platform business services in China. It operates through Parking Fee, Winery Sales, and Others segments. The company offers the Any-e Life platform, an app that enables users to check and reserve parking spaces, enter and exit parking lots without delay, and pay seamlessly with fees deducted automatically. It also provides technology development, smart parking projects, smart parking mobile applications, and cloud platform construction services. In addition, the company sells wine products. It serves city planners, parking lot operators, car owners, and cooperative businesses. Jingbo Technology, Inc. was founded in 2022 and is based in Fuyang, China.
